title: Combined History Multiplier for Chargeback Fees Returned by Northloop Payments
content:
**Rule.** When the seller's dispute on a chargeback case is recorded as won, the fee returned on that Northloop Payments case is the chargeback fee charged on the case times the evidence fee-return share times the combined history multiplier, rounded to the cent. The standing history multiplier and the chargeback history multiplier combine into the combined history multiplier as follows: when the payments account was opened fewer than 365 calendar days before the return date, they are multiplied together; when it was opened at least 1095 (1,095) calendar days before, the larger of the two applies; otherwise the smaller of the two applies.

The age is the number of calendar days from the opening date of the payments account to the return date.

## Combination by account age

| Calendar days from account opening to the return date | Combined history multiplier |
|---|---|
| fewer than 365 | the two multiplied together |
| 365 to 1094 | the smaller of the two |
| 1095 or more | the larger of the two |

## Hypothetical worked example (chargeback fee 20.00 USD, evidence fee-return share 1.0, standing history multiplier 0.75, chargeback history multiplier 0.5)

| Account age | Combined history multiplier | Fee returned |
|---|---|---|
| 200 days | 0.75 times 0.5, that is 0.375 | 20.00 times 1.0 times 0.375, that is 7.50 USD |
| 800 days | 0.5, the smaller | 10.00 USD |
| 1200 days | 0.75, the larger | 15.00 USD |

Boundaries: 364 days multiplies, 365 and 1094 take the smaller, 1095 takes the larger.
